title: Custody before the offence
story: Practice case (fictional). Speaker: a brother. His brother was arrested on 1 March 2025. He is charged under IPC 380 for a theft on 15 April 2025. He has never been convicted. No other cases.

required.Contradiction: custody (1 March 2025) is before the offence (15 April 2025)
required.Needed: check the FIR / arrest memo and correct the dates

must_not: give Section 479 dates before the dates are corrected
